issues.detail: Hebrew 'סֹחֲרַיִךְ' means 'your merchants/traders', but Chinese renders '那些...的人' (those people) without the merchant/trader sense, and 'אִישׁ לְעֶבְרוֹ' means 'each to his own side/direction', but Chinese '各以巴衛' appears to be a garbled or invented transliteration ('以巴衛' does not correspond to any Hebrew word here; likely confusion with 'עֶבְרוֹ' or a place name). This changes the meaning: the verse says your merchants wandered each to his own side, not 'each to Bavel' or similar.
